title: Match countries to capitals: Asia
intro: Match each capital city with its country in Asia.

pairs.explain: Kabul is the capital of Afghanistan.
Yerevan is the capital of Armenia.
Baku is the capital of Azerbaijan.
Amman is the capital of Jordan.
Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
Bishkek is the capital of Kyrgyzstan.
Dushanbe is the capital of Tajikistan.
Dili is the capital of Timor-Leste.
